scripts.build: npm run build:reader && npm run build:sync
scripts.open: npm run open:browser && npm run open:url
scripts.build:sync: vite build --config sync/vite.config.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config sync/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test: npm run test:local && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:live-site && npm run test:live-studyz
scripts.test:production: npm run test:sync-production && npm run test:live-open && npm run test:live-sync && npm run test:live-studyz-sync && npm run test:live-dashboard && npm run test:copy-failure-production
scripts.test:local: npm run test:dependencies && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:repository-naming && npm run test:static-cache-policy && npm run test:config && npm run test:launcher && npm run test:open-study && npm run test:appium-cli && npm run test:release-script && npm run test:live-sync-script && npm run test:reader && npm run test:sync
scripts.test:reader: npm run build:reader && node --test reader/tests/markdown.test.mjs reader/tests/sites.test.mjs reader/tests/study_time_controller_test.mjs reader/tests/copy_controller_test.mjs reader/tests/build_test.mjs reader/tests/feedback_kpi_test.mjs reader/tests/runtime_recycle_test.mjs reader/tests/swipe_navigation_test.mjs reader/tests/userscript_metadata_test.mjs && acorn --ecma2020 --silent reader/dist/exam-practice-reader.user.js
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build:sync && node reader/tests/smoke_test.js && node reader/tests/time_limit_smoke_test.js && node reader/tests/ios_smoke_test.js && node sync/tests/dashboard_e2e_test.js
scripts.deploy:sync: npm test && wrangler deploy --config sync/wrangler.jsonc && npm run test:production
